name: @local/visited-map
description: A demo-ready shared world map of countries and US states, with family membership and travel data stored in the app data folder.

integrations.reason: Identifies the current family member so the map can default to their view.

tools.name: tag_visit
tools.description: Tag or untag a family member for a country or US state on the visited map. Accepts common country/state names; the tool looks up the internal place ID automatically.

place.description: Country or US state name, e.g. 'Italy', 'Japan', 'California'.

personId.description: A stable person id from the family membership config.json file.

visited.description: If true, add the visited tag; if false, remove it. Mutually exclusive with 'want'.

want.description: If true, tag as 'want to visit'; if false, remove it. Mutually exclusive with 'visited'.
